subject: Weekly MAP Checkpoint: SDK/API auth, streaming & tool-calls
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Li <sam.li@integracom.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly MAP check-in: SDK/API auth, streaming & tool-calls

Sam / Integracom team —

Quick weekly checkpoint from our side ahead of today’s sync (1pm PT). High level: we want to confirm owners and near-term close blockers for the MAP so we can keep the June close window. Below are current statuses and asks.

1) SDK integration (mobile + node) — owner: Karthik
   - Status: SDK PRs split (node 85% green, mobile still failing on auth handshake).
   - Ask: Karthik to confirm ETA for mobile fix (we need a release candidate by Friday).

2) API auth & token exchange — owner: Monica
   - Status: prototype for rotating client creds complete; need Integracom to accept the new refresh grant in their Auth server.
   - Attach: auth-flow.png (diagram of token exchange).
   - Ask: Sam, can your security team confirm the refresh grant mapping by EOD Thursday?

3) Streaming (server-sent events) — owner: Sean
   - Status: end-to-end streaming works in dev but we’re seeing intermittent reconnects at token refresh boundaries.
   - Ask: Share logs showing the reconnect pattern (sample attached: integration-design-v2.pdf shows sequence).

4) Tool calling / function schema — owner: Grace
   - Status: draft schema reviewed; Integracom requested a change to the tool metadata field names.
   - Ask: agree on final schema by next Tuesday so we can include in eval harness.

Action items (short):
- Karthik: mobile SDK auth fix — ETA? (owner)
- Monica: coordinate token grant mapping with Integracom security (Sam)
- Sean: attach a sample reconnect trace when token rotates
- Sam: confirm ability to accept refresh grant & comment on schema changes

I’ve attached a one-page MAP action sheet (MAP-action-items.xlsx) and the integration design doc (integration-design-v2.pdf) for reference.

Thanks — see you at 1pm PT.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Head of GTM Engineering (partnerships)
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-06-07T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP check-in: SDK/API auth, streaming & tool-calls

Thanks Rishi — good summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side before the 1pm: 

- Refresh grant: our security lead (cc’d as partners@integracom.com) reviewed the flow and has two asks: (A) log-level for refresh events (PII redaction) and (B) a slightly different claim name (iss -> issuer) for backward compatibility. Both are manageable but we need to confirm by Thursday EOD.

- Streaming reconnects: we’ve started a 24h soak in staging and saw similar reconnect spikes when the token rotates. We’ll attach the raw trace after today’s run (expect by 4pm PT).

- Tool schema: Sam here (Integracom product). We prefer the metadata key tool_id over toolName; we’ll send a short diff. If Redwood is OK, this should be a non-blocker.

Also attached a small sample log snippet inlined below for immediate visibility.

-----Inline sample log start-----
[2027-06-07T10:12:03Z] stream: client=abc123 token_refresh=initiated
[2027-06-07T10:12:03Z] stream: client=abc123 connection_close code=1001
[2027-06-07T10:12:04Z] stream: client=abc123 reconnection attempt=1
-----Inline sample log end-----

We’ll confirm refresh claim name and soak logs by 4pm PT. On the mobile SDK: our mobile eng lead reports the handshake fails when the auth library sends a nonced challenge; we can pair with Karthik this afternoon if that helps.

Sam
Sam Li
Integrations Lead — Integracom Solutions
[Attachment: integracom-staging-trace-20270607.txt (text/plain)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP check-in: SDK/API auth, streaming & tool-calls

Rishi — quick technical update following Sam’s note and a short debugging run this morning.

SDK (mobile): the failing handshake is reproducible when the client sends a pre-1.0 challenge header (legacy). We have a patch that normalizes the challenge header and a unit test; integration tests start at 3pm PT. If the staging soak from Integracom goes green we can cut a release candidate tonight.

API auth: Monica and I paired on the refresh mapping. The change is additive (we accept both iss and issuer claims for 30 days). We’ll include a short migration guide in the SDK release notes.

Streaming: reconnection on token rotate looks like a timing edge where client-side reconnect kicks in before the new token is bound to the session. Proposed mitigation: delay client reconnect by 350ms after token refresh OR perform opaque session handoff at the server. I’ll prototype the delay approach in the SDK and run it against Integracom’s soak trace.

Tool-calling schema: I reviewed Integracom’s diff (tool_id) and it’s fine. Grace will update the canonical schema and push to the eval harness by Monday.

Action items I own:
- Ship mobile SDK patch (RC candidate) — ETA: 2027-06-10
- Prototype 350ms reconnect delay experiment and report results — ETA: 2027-06-08

I’ll drop the unit/integration logs into the shared Drive link.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Software Engineer, SDKs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sdk-mobile-patch.diff (text/plain)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Li <sam.li@integracom.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP check-in: SDK/API auth, streaming & tool-calls — action recap

Great progress everyone — thanks for the rapid turn. Final recap and owners: 

- Karthik: mobile SDK patch + prototype reconnect delay (350ms) — deliverables: RC build + experiment results (ETA: 2027-06-08 / 2027-06-10).
- Monica: finalize token grant mapping with Integracom security (confirm claim aliasing) — ETA: 2027-06-10.
- Sam / Integracom: provide full staging trace and confirm support for refresh grant (deliver by 2027-06-07 16:00 PT; received trace pending review).
- Grace: finalize tool-calling schema with tool_id change and publish to eval harness (ETA: 2027-06-14).

Next sync: keep weekly cadence — same time next Tuesday 1pm PT unless either team requests an escalation. I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with these owners and ETAs.

If any of you want a short pairing session on the mobile handshake I can make time tomorrow morning.

Cheers,
Rishi
Head of GTM Engineering (partnerships)
Redwood Inference
